diagnosis: The prospectively frozen log-state coordinate transform prevented an accepted root in all three cases. Many starts returned a nominally successful fsolve exit flag while retaining residuals around 1e-4, far above the frozen 1e-9 acceptance gate. This is a numerical-coordinate failure, not evidence that the TR=1 equilibrium is absent. In log coordinates, dF/dz = dF/dx * x can become artificially small as candidate components approach zero, allowing step/optimality stopping without satisfying the physical residual gate.
next_safe_action: Version the root solver only: use the identical frozen multistart seeds and acceptance criteria in physical state coordinates, filter final roots for positivity, and keep the Jacobian/stability rule unchanged. Do not extend the multistart set or change residual thresholds after seeing this result.
